mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in WORKPLACES mobility (-49.6% at t-0w) signals persistent remote work adoption. This reduces commuter-adjacent retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks as the baseline of office-anchored shopping erodes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -19.3% to -49.6% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses to positive territory within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Sharp acceleration in RESIDENTIAL mobility (+4.3% at t-0w, up from +0.9%) indicates heightened home-based activity and reduced outdoor engagement. This behavioral shift toward indoor confinement suppresses retail-and-recreation visits over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased from +0.9% to +4.3% over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility declines below +2.0% within one week, or RETAIL_REC increases despite sustained RESIDENTIAL elevation above +3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility collapsed to -41.3% at t-0w, indicating severe public transport avoidance. This transit deficit prevents non-car-dependent populations from reaching retail destinations, compounding RETAIL_REC decline over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -26.7% to -41.3% over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT recovers above -20.0% within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises despite TRANSIT remaining below -35.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent collapse in GROCERY_PHARM (-13.7% at t-0w) and RETAIL_REC (-30.4%) signals broad-based consumer avoidance of all public-facing venues. This synchronized contraction reflects fear-driven behavioral suppression that will persist, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: both GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC decline by more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell -13.7% and RETAIL_REC fell -30.4% at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC recovers above -15.0% while GROCERY_PHARM remains below -10.0%, indicating decoupling of the two series.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility spiked to +62.4% at t-0w, indicating outdoor recreation preference during summer. However, this outdoor substitution effect diverts discretionary spending away from indoor retail venues, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks despite high outdoor activity.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above -20.0% while PARKS remains above +50.0%, or PARKS declines below +40.0% within one week.

mechanism_narrative: Synchronized deterioration across TRANSIT (-41.3%), WORKPLACES (-49.6%), and RESIDENTIAL (+4.3%) indicates active restriction regime. Under such regime, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed as mobility constraints persist, preventing recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -35.0% AND WORKPLACES below -40.0% AND RESIDENTIAL above +3.0% simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:All three conditions met at t-0w
failure_condition: Any two of the three trigger conditions reverse within one week, or RETAIL_REC rises above -20.0% despite all three conditions remaining active.
